description: This source file defines an interface 'RetrieveFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder' used for building command responses related to feature definitions in a live command context. It provides nested interfaces to create response objects such as successful feature definition retrievals and error responses, specifically for 'RetrieveFeatureDefinition' commands within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface extending query command response builder for building responses for RetrieveFeatureDefinition commands.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Nested interface defining factory methods to create response objects for feature definition retrieval success or failure.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a response containing the retrieved FeatureDefinition.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature definition could not be accessed.
